messages:
Alyssa: Observing steady GPU RSS growth on staging when kvcache + workspace pooling are enabled. Not hitting OOM but resident keeps creeping up over ~6h.
Dan: Can you drop an nvml snapshot + the small repro you used? quick sanity checks first.
Alyssa: nvml snips attached. Example trend: 5.2GB -> 5.7GB over 3h on the same worker process. My quick loop is basically a long generate loop pinning one replica:
``nfor i in range(10000):
    client.generate(model="redwood-3b-v1", prompt=prompt)
```
Perf-bot: I ran the allocation tracer against that load. Hot path: repeated workspace alloc/free around attention kernels and lots of kvcache grow operations. No single big allocation, many small ones. NVTX traces point to fused-attn path often.
Matt: Sounds like fragmentation from repeated small allocs in the workspace arena. Did we change workspace sizing or allocator knobs recently?
Alyssa: We rolled a batching heuristic change last week that increases mean sequence length per batch. Also kernel selector was updated to prefer fused-attn for seq_len > 128.
Seoyeon: Try toggling pooling: set WORKSPACE_POOL_MAX=0 to disable pooling and run with DEBUG_ALLOC=1 to get full traces. If fragmentation/pool bug then disabling should flatten RSS.
Alyssa: Did that. With pooling disabled RSS stabilizes after an initial ramp. With pooling enabled it grows. So pooling + kvcache seems correlated.
Dan: Could be buffer reuse policy failing to account for kv block lifetimes. Maybe we keep workspace buffers referenced by evicted blocks or leave a pointer behind. Any weak-ref issues?
Matt: Check reclaim path when kv blocks are evicted. There was one race where eviction during in-flight ops marks blocks dead but doesn't release the workspace slot. Pseudo check:
``nif kv_block.evicted():
    workspace.release(block.workspace_slot)
```
Alyssa: I grepped and found a codepath where we mark the block dead and enqueue for cleanup but skip release if op.finish() hasn't run. Looks like a race.
Infra-bot: Note: kernel-picker fused-attn change deployed in commit b7c3f2a on 2026-03-10; fused kernel uses different temporaries which might change allocation patterns.
Dan: Action plan: 1) create a minimal repro script that toggles kvcache size and pooling; 2) run DEBUG_ALLOC for alloc traces; 3) if repro is deterministic, bisect allocator commits.
Matt: I'll author a deterministic reproscript with seeded workloads, run for 1h, and emit nvml snapshots every minute. Will attach repro and traces. Also adding a small unit that simulates eviction during op for the allocator test.
Alyssa: Adding dashboard metric: per-replica RSS over time + kvcache bytes to correlate.
Seoyeon: If repro is fast enough I'll run a binary bisection across allocator changes. Also test forcing fallback kernel instead of fused-attn to see if allocation pattern changes.
Matt: If we confirm race, patch to always release buffers on eviction and add unit/integration test simulating concurrent eviction + active ops.
Alyssa: Thanks all :thumbsup:
